findings.statement: FramePool50, FramePool100 and FramePoolCombined in the paper. The Kipoi model Framepool uses the weights file Framepool_combined_residual.h5. The code repository also holds other .h5 model files whose mapping to these names is not documented in the sources read.
findings.source_says: No saved file lists the contents of the Karollus/5UTR repository; readme.md mentions no .h5 files. The only weights file named in the saved sources is Framepool_combined_residual.h5.
findings.fix: FramePool50, FramePool100 and FramePoolCombined in the paper. The Kipoi model Framepool uses the weights file Framepool_combined_residual.h5.

summary: Reliable. Architecture, weight counts, training data, licences and the Kipoi commands match the PLOS Computational Biology full text, the Kipoi model definition and page, and the README; one remark about other repository files has no saved source.
